notes.title: Hello employees
notes.notes:
Just a quick update. 

I'm currently working on implementing day two of the warehouse. The mechanics are in place and I'm now in the middle of building the map for it. It'll play out differently than day one and instead of being a forklift driver, you'll take up another role for the day! I don't have an exact ETA on when it will be published, but I will let you all know when it's getting closer.

I've also been working on fixing bugs present in day one and polishing up some issues on the map. Namely the dreaded forklift. Once day two hits, the requirements for finishing day one with the forklift will be lessened, so fear not.

[b]Now, get back to work. Time is money.[/b]
